raw:
Agent Name: Planner
Step Number: 1
Reason for Mistake: The Planner made a factual error in comparing the masses of subatomic particles. It incorrectly stated that the proton has a mass of $1.67 \times 10^{-27}$ kg and the electron has a mass of $9.11 \times 10^{-27}$ kg, concluding the proton is lighter. In reality, the electron is significantly lighter than the proton (approximately 1/1836th the mass). The correct comparison is $m_e \ll m_p \approx m_n$, making the electron the lightest part of the atom listed.
